Description

Every playable race gets 2-3 new passive abilities, and you decide how strong they are. Pick a race in the in-game menu and drag its slider anywhere from 0 to 200%. Too strong? Turn it down. Want a Nord who shrugs off winter? Turn it up.

The point is control. Instead of a race overhaul you either take or leave, this lets you tune each race to taste, per character.


Requirements

- SKSE64 (required)
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins (required)
- SKSE Menu Framework (optional - only for the in-game menu; the passives work without it)

Built and tested on Skyrim SE 1.5.97. No VR build.


Main features

Per-race intensity slider (F1 > Race Passives)
- One slider per race, 0 to 200%
- Live values listed under each slider, so you see what you are actually getting
- Overview page showing every race at a glance, plus a "Reload config from ini" button
- 0% switches a race off completely. Multiplicative effects cap at 100%.

The passives (numbers below are what you get at 100%)

Nord
- Frost Resistance +25% (additive)
- Shout Cooldown -20% (multiplicative)
- Health Regeneration +50% below half health (additive)

Orc
- Maximum Health +50 (additive)
- Attack Damage +20% below half health (multiplicative)

Breton
- Magic Resistance +25% (additive)
- Spell Absorption 10% (additive)
- Magicka Regeneration +100% below half health (additive)

Dunmer
- Fire Resistance +25% (additive)
- Attack Damage +20% below half health (multiplicative)

Altmer
- Maximum Magicka +50 (additive)
- Magicka Regeneration +50% (additive)

Khajiit
- Unarmed Damage +12 (additive)
- Movement Speed +10% (additive)
- Stamina Regeneration +25% (additive)

Argonian
- Disease Resistance +25% (additive)
- Poison Resistance +25% (additive)
- Health Regeneration while swimming (additive)

Redguard
- Maximum Stamina +50 (additive)
- Stamina Regeneration +50% (additive)
- Poison Resistance +25% (additive)

Bosmer
- Bow Draw Speed +50% (additive)
- Disease Resistance +25% (additive)
- Poison Resistance +25% (additive)

Imperial
- Better Buy / Sell Prices (multiplicative)
- Skill Learning +10% (multiplicative)
- Armor +50 in combat (additive)

Settings carry over
- Stored in SKSE/Plugins/RacePassives.ini and re-applied on every load
- New characters and existing saves share the same set. Edit the file by hand and hit "Reload config from ini" to apply it without restarting

Won't clash with your other mods
- Only adds new records; nothing vanilla and nothing from another mod is overwritten
- Stacks with race overhauls (Imperious, Morningstar, Even Better Race, and similar)
- Load order does not matter for conflicts, since there is nothing to override


Custom races
- Using custom race mods? You can map a custom race onto one of the sets above.
- Open the menu (F1) > Custom Races to see your current race's EditorID.
- Add a line under [CustomRaces] in SKSE/Plugins/RacePassives.ini, e.g. MyCustomNord=Nord
- Hit "Reload config from ini" on the Overview page. That race now uses the Nord set and its slider.


Installation instructions

1. Install with your mod manager. The installer asks whether you want English or Chinese text.
2. Enable the plugin.

Uninstalling mid-save
The mod puts abilities on your character, so clean up first:
1. In game, press F1 > Overview > "Disable all (before uninstalling)"
2. Save the game
3. Then remove the mod

If you skip that, the save usually still loads, but it keeps references to records that no longer exist. ReSaver can clean those out.


Shout outs

- Built with CommonLibSSE-NG
- Menu courtesy of SKSE Menu Framework
- Translations are welcome - just keep this page listed as a requirement
